stem: A two-sided two-proportion z-test gives z = 1.80. As reference points, |z| = 1.645 gives p = 0.10, |z| = 1.96 gives p = 0.05 and |z| = 2.58 gives p = 0.01. Where does the p-value lie, and is the result significant at α = 0.05?

options.text: Between 0.01 and 0.05, so significant at the 5% level
Below 0.01, so significant even at the 1% level
Between 0.05 and 0.10, so not significant at the 5% level
Above 0.10, which shows that there is no effect at all
